current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s kind of hard to put straight. Over the last maybe eight months I’ve been getting this growing feeling that the neighbours are watching me, like talking about me, and sometimes I hear my name being called when nobody’s there. I know that sounds… I still question if it’s real, you know? It’s been making me pull back from my college course too, which is a mess because I was trying to get that finished.
current_concerns.goals: I want to work out what is happening to me… and get back to my course, basically.
